title: Kriging and Neural Network models for pressure losses across perforated plates
abstract: arXiv:2606.29628v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, two novel data-driven models based on Kriging and neural networks (NN) are proposed to predict pressure losses across perforated plates with circular perforations in turbulent flows. The models are developed using two sets of experimental data available in the literature. The predictive performance of the proposed models is assessed and compared against widely used empirical formulae. It is found that the proposed models consistently outperform existing empirical models for most perforated plate configurations contained in the experimental datasets. Besides, the predicted pressure losses generally show good agreement with experimental measurements, demonstrating that data-driven approaches based on Kriging and NN provide a feasible framework for modelling pressure losses across perforated plates. translated_title: 用于穿孔板压力损失的克里金与神经网络模型
translated_abstract: 本文提出了两种基于克里金（Kriging）和神经网络（NN）的新型数据驱动模型，用于预测湍流条件下圆形穿孔板两侧的压力损失。这些模型利用文献中已有的两组实验数据进行开发。文中对所提出模型的预测性能进行了评估，并与广泛使用的经验公式进行了比较。研究发现，对于实验数据集中所包含的大多数穿孔板构型，所提出的模型始终优于现有的经验模型。此外，预测的压力损失与实验测量结果总体吻合良好，表明基于克里金和神经网络的数据驱动方法为穿孔板压力损失建模提供了一个可行的框架。总体而言，尽管这两种方法都是在相对有限的实验数据上训练的，但它们都具有广阔的应用前景。
tldr: 本文提出基于克里金和神经网络的两种数据驱动模型，在预测湍流中圆形穿孔板压力损失方面始终优于传统经验公式，即使训练数据有限也展现出良好的准确性和应用前景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two novel data-driven models based on Kriging and neural networks that consistently outperform existing empirical formulae in predicting pressure losses across circular perforated plates in turbulent flows, showing promising accuracy even with limited training data.
